page_title: DOR 4-0 FRE | Dortmund v Freiburg 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Felix Brych produces a RED card from his pocket and Junior Adamu (Freiburg) heads for an early shower!

90+2' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Junior Adamu (Freiburg), but referee Felix Brych must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+2' The referee blows his whistle as Junior Adamu (Freiburg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pascal Gross (Dortmund) takes it short.
84' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) trips an opposition player and Felix Brych signals a foul.
82' Substitution. Almugera Kabar (Dortmund) replaces Julian Ryerson.
81' It's time for a substitution. Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) comes on in place of Lucas Holer.
80' Yan Couto (Dortmund) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
78' Nuri Sahin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Reyna (Dortmund) replacing Julian Brandt.
78' A substitution has been made. Jamie Gittens is replaced by Julien Duranville (Dortmund).
78' The game has come to an end for Ramy Bensebaini. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Yan Couto (Dortmund).
77' 4 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) was set free in the area by Ramy Bensebaini and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top right corner. 4:0.
75' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
73' Here is a change. Ritsu Doan is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg).
73' Here comes a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo is given a rest as he is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).

73' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
73' Corner kick. Pascal Gross (Dortmund) is ready to send the ball into the box.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcel Sabitzer departs the field of play to be replaced by Pascal Gross (Dortmund).
66' 3 - 0 Julian Brandt (Dortmund) scores a goal from the resulting free kick, sending it into the top right corner. What a strike that is, absolutely fantastic!
64' The game is interrupted now, Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Felix Brych blows his whistle and Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
61' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' The substitution has been made. Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) has replaced Lukas Kubler.
61' Julian Schuster prepares a substitution. Nicolas Hofler is replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
60' The resulting corner from Julian Brandt (Dortmund) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
58' What was Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
57' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu was alert and made a comfortable save.
55' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
49' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
47' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
47' Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
45' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
43' Rough tackle by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
40' 2 - 0 Goal! Jamie Gittens tees up Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top left corner. 2:0.
35' A snap shot by Donyell Malen (Dortmund) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Noah Atubolu produces a good save to thwart him.
29' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Felix Brych blows for a foul.

28' Excellent touch by Julian Brandt (Dortmund)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
24' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
24' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the bar!

24' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Gregor Kobel has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
23' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
21' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Jamie Gittens (Dortmund) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Noah Atubolu easily catches the ball.
20' Felix Brych couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Julian Brandt (Dortmund) and blew his whistle.
12' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
7' 1 - 0 Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) latches on to an inch-perfect pass and produces a low drive from the edge of the box which goes into the middle of the goal and past the helpless goalkeeper.
1' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Felix Brych interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Dortmund will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Felix Brych.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
